rules: Write natural everyday action at normal real-time speed; no slow motion unless separately requested and authorized.
Each shot has a meaningful purpose and cause-to-effect action, not a tiny step followed by an arbitrary frozen pose.
Provide exactly one continuous visual beat for every second of the shot; cover the entire duration and include its end state. Do not repeat a completed stop action as continuing motion.
Vary framing and at most one clearly directed camera move according to the story. Never hardcode static camera and identical gestures for every shot.
Human faces remain smooth and featureless; emotion uses posture, movement and composition. No smiling, blinking or facial performance.
Visual prompts contain no dialogue, narration or requests for native voice. ElevenLabs supplies audio; no music.
Reference identity, clothing, props, skin tone for faceless and per-preset style are locked. Do not use faceless human references in stickman.

An image QC pass is not a video QC pass. Rendered faceless clips require temporal face inspection before assembly. Technical playback or Drive upload is not visual approval. Motion naturalness needs separate review.
